golf.label: Golf
golf.camera: Face-on: tripod at hip height, 3-4 m in front of you, lens pointing at your belt buckle.

metrics.label: Tempo (backswing : downswing)
metrics.cue_low: Your backswing is rushed. Take the club back slower and smoother.
metrics.cue_high: Your downswing is quick relative to a slow backswing. Keep one smooth rhythm.

metrics.label: Lead arm at the top
metrics.cue_low: Your lead arm is collapsing at the top. Keep it long and wide.
metrics.note: 2D pose under-reads a straight arm; only arms more bent than the pros are penalised

metrics.label: Head sway to impact
metrics.cue_high: Your head is drifting sideways. Keep it centred over the ball until impact.

metrics.label: Head height change at impact
metrics.cue_low: You are standing up through impact. Stay in your posture.
metrics.cue_high: You are dipping down into the ball. Keep your height level.

metrics.label: Hip sway in backswing
metrics.cue_high: Your hips slide away from the target. Turn around your trail hip instead of swaying.

metrics.label: Shoulder turn at the top
metrics.cue_high: Your shoulder turn is short. Rotate your back to the target.

metrics.label: Finish over lead foot
metrics.cue_high: You are finishing on your back foot. Get your weight onto your lead side.

basketball.label: Basketball shot
basketball.camera: Face-on: tripod at chest height, 3-5 m in front of you, on the line between you and the hoop. Shoot one-handed: guide hand on the side of the ball, so the app can read your shooting arm.

metrics.label: Leg drive into the shot
metrics.cue_low: Use your legs. Dip and rise so the shot starts from the ground.

metrics.label: Elbow extension at release
metrics.cue_low: You are short-arming the release. Extend fully up through the ball.

metrics.label: Elbow flare at set point
metrics.cue_high: Your elbow is flaring out. Tuck it under the ball, in line with your shoulder.

metrics.label: Release height above shoulder
metrics.cue_low: You are releasing low. Shoot up, not out, and finish high.

metrics.label: Arm line at release
metrics.cue_high: Your arm is finishing across your body. Finish straight toward the rim.

metrics.label: Follow-through hold
metrics.cue_low: Hold your follow-through until the ball reaches the rim.

metrics.label: Sideways drift
metrics.cue_high: You are drifting sideways. Go straight up and land where you took off.

metrics.label: Dip-to-release time
metrics.cue_low: Your release is rushed after the dip. Let the legs finish first.
metrics.cue_high: There is a hitch between your dip and your release. Make it one motion.

metrics.label: One-hand release
metrics.cue_low: Shoot with one hand. Keep your guide hand on the side of the ball and let only your shooting hand push it.

tennis.label: Tennis
tennis.camera: Face-on: tripod 6-8 m in front of you (across the net), lens at chest height. Best for volleys and net play.

metrics.label: Staying low while loading
metrics.cue_high: Bend your knees more as you load. Power comes from the ground up.

metrics.label: Arm extension at contact
metrics.cue_low: Reach up on your serve. Hit at full stretch above your hitting shoulder, not with a bent arm.
metrics.note: groundstroke extension is invisible face-on (arm points at the camera)

metrics.label: Contact height
metrics.cue_low: You are meeting the ball too high. Let it drop into your strike zone.
metrics.cue_high: You are meeting the ball too low. Get under it with your legs, or reach up fully on serve.

metrics.label: Swing through the ball
metrics.cue_low: You are cutting your swing short. Finish across your body.

metrics.label: Unit turn
metrics.cue_high: Turn earlier and fully: by the end of your take-back your shoulders should be sideways, with your non-hitting shoulder pointing at the ball.

metrics.label: Head stability into contact
metrics.cue_high: Your head is moving through the hit. Keep your eyes at the contact point.

metrics.label: Backswing-to-contact time
metrics.cue_low: You are snatching at the ball. Smooth acceleration beats a late rush.
metrics.cue_high: Your forward swing is slow. Accelerate through contact.

metrics.label: Finish over your shoulder
metrics.cue_low: Finish over your shoulder: keep swinging until the racket wraps up and over your opposite shoulder.

metrics.label: Elbow at nose level at the finish
metrics.cue_low: Finish with your hitting elbow up at nose height, pointing toward your target.

metrics.label: Other hand out for spacing
metrics.cue_low: Use your other hand: reach it out toward the ball as you turn, to judge the space between you and the ball.

metrics.label: Spacing from the ball
metrics.cue_low: You're jammed: give yourself more room between your body and the ball.
metrics.cue_high: You're reaching for the ball: move your feet so it comes to you.

side.camera: Side-on: tripod 4-6 m to your forehand side, lens at 1.0-1.3 m, level with where you hit the ball. Best for contact point, weight transfer and serves.

metrics.label: Contact height
metrics.cue_low: You are meeting the ball too high. Let it drop into your strike zone.
metrics.cue_high: You are meeting the ball too low. Get under it with your legs, or reach up fully on serve.

metrics.label: Backswing-to-contact time
metrics.cue_low: You are snatching at the ball. Smooth acceleration beats a late rush.
metrics.cue_high: Your forward swing is slow. Accelerate through contact.

metrics.label: Finish over your shoulder
metrics.cue_low: Finish over your shoulder: keep swinging until the racket wraps up and over your opposite shoulder.

metrics.label: Elbow at nose level at the finish
metrics.cue_low: Finish with your hitting elbow up at nose height, pointing toward your target.

metrics.label: Other hand out for spacing
metrics.cue_low: Use your other hand: reach it out toward the ball as you turn, to judge the space between you and the ball.

metrics.label: Contact out in front
metrics.cue_low: Make contact further in front of you, out ahead of your front foot.

metrics.label: Extend through the ball
metrics.cue_low: Extend out toward your target through contact before wrapping to the finish.

metrics.label: Load the back leg
metrics.cue_high: Load your back leg on the take-back: sit your weight over your back foot.
metrics.note: only measured with staggered feet; open-stance strokes load and rotate instead

metrics.label: Transfer to the front leg
metrics.cue_low: Push off your back leg and move your weight onto your front leg through contact.
metrics.note: only measured with staggered feet; open-stance strokes load and rotate instead

metrics.label: Arm extension at contact
metrics.cue_low: Fully extend your hitting arm at contact on the backhand and serve.
metrics.note: modern forehands contact with a bent elbow (about 100-130 deg, Reid et al. 2013), so only backhand and serve are judged

training.label: Groundstrokes
training.why: From behind, the camera sees your spacing from the ball, your turn and your finish.

training.label: Contact point & weight transfer
training.why: Side-on is the only view that shows how far in front you hit and how your weight moves forward.

training.label: Serve
training.why: Side-on shows your reach, extension and how you drive up into the ball.

training.label: Volleys & net play
training.why: Face-on, like a player across the net, shows your ready position and compact swing.

pickleball.label: Pickleball
pickleball.camera: Face-on: tripod at chest height, 3-5 m in front of you (at or behind the net, facing you).

metrics.label: Staying low
metrics.cue_high: Stay lower. Bend your knees instead of bending at the waist.

metrics.label: Paddle-up ready position
metrics.cue_high: Your paddle is dropping between shots. Keep it up at chest height.

metrics.label: Compact backswing
metrics.cue_high: Your backswing is too big. Keep the paddle in front of your body.

metrics.label: Arm extension at contact
metrics.cue_low: Reach up on your overhead. Hit at full stretch above your hitting shoulder, not with a bent arm.
metrics.note: groundstroke extension is invisible face-on (arm points at the camera)

metrics.label: Contact height
metrics.cue_low: You are reaching up for balls you could let drop.
metrics.cue_high: You are hitting from too low. Bend and lift with your legs.

metrics.label: Follow-through
metrics.cue_low: You are stabbing at the ball. Push through toward your target.

metrics.label: Head stability into contact
metrics.cue_high: Keep your head still and watch the ball onto the paddle.
